items.statementText: SELECT input, output, tool_output FROM user_ai_agent_tool_history ORDER BY start_date DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

items.input: {"TOOL_NAME":"NINA_HIGHTECH_SQL_TOOL","QUERY":"SELECT component.name, component.category, SUM(production_order_lines.line_total) AS total_material_value, production_order.planned_units FROM production_order_lines JOIN production_order ON production_order_lines.order_id = production_order.id JOIN component ON production_order_lines.component_id = component.id WHERE production_order.order_status IN ('released', 'in_production', 'completed') GROUP BY component.name, component.category, production_order.planned_units ORDER BY total_material_value DESC LIMIT 5","ACTION":"RUNSQL"}
